speaker: davy_gannet
text: The Queen's at Greenwich with five thousand men about her, the Rose'll not open till Christmas, and it'll thunder.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: A penny. The other bank is the same air, and the penny is the same penny.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No. I have not been over the water since May. I am not going tonight.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Then sit on my stair till you are tired of the smell. I have no fare, and the news was free.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The smell is weed, and mash, and worse. The air I came for is not here either.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: It'll thunder. I have said it. A moon will come up whether I am right or not. I am tarring the keel.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tar it. I will stay till the moon. I am not buying the crossing.
